description: This file contains functions and a class related to representing and manipulating text positions within a document, likely for a code editor or similar application. It includes position creation, comparison, copying, and clipping within document bounds.

classes.name: Pos
classes.description: Represents a position within a text document with line, character, and optional sticky information.

methods.name: Pos
methods.description: Constructor for creating a Pos object with line, character, and optional sticky property.

methods.name: cmp(a, b)
methods.description: Compares two Pos objects, returning 0 if equal, negative if a < b, positive if a > b.

methods.name: equalCursorPos(a, b)
methods.description: Checks if two Pos objects have the same sticky property and are at the same position.

methods.name: copyPos(x)
methods.description: Creates a copy of a given Pos object.

methods.name: maxPos(a, b)
methods.description: Returns the greater of two Pos objects based on their position.

methods.name: minPos(a, b)
methods.description: Returns the lesser of two Pos objects based on their position.

methods.name: clipLine(doc, n)
methods.description: Ensures a line number is within the document's range.

methods.name: clipPos(doc, pos)
methods.description: Adjusts a Pos object to fit within document bounds, considering line length.

methods.name: clipToLen(pos, linelen)
methods.description: Helper function to ensure character position is within line length.

methods.name: clipPosArray(doc, array)
methods.description: Clips an array of Pos objects to stay within document bounds.

ctags.name: cmp
ctags.pattern: /^export function cmp(a, b) { return a.line - b.line || a.ch - b.ch }$/

ctags.name: equalCursorPos
ctags.pattern: /^export function equalCursorPos(a, b) { return a.sticky == b.sticky && cmp(a, b) == 0 }$/

ctags.name: maxPos
ctags.pattern: /^export function maxPos(a, b) { return cmp(a, b) < 0 ? b : a }$/
